Summary of websites posted in #general:
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brings mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It's clear and friendly, and I like that your hiking hobby is front and center. It would be even better with some posts, photos of your hikes, trail recommendations and a few navigation links. Nice start!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's simple and clear, and it's handy that your contact email is easy to find. It could be improved with more about you, such as your projects, interests or portfolio, plus some visuals and a clearer layout. Nice start!
